_: The square's own life in a market town (town_life.gd _square_life; art target docs/art/target/town-composition/town-b: a square packed with shoppers, porters, children, dogs, a crier, guards and beggars, each there for a reason). on: the switch (--crowd=off). off: with it off, the crown's market as it was before the crowd work (towns.json market.crown's buyers, porters, carts, how many the square holds and its places hold, how many are out), so on and off show the whole difference. min_size: towns this big or bigger get it, and the crown's seat always. Each row: how many by the town's state (works.json priority; base, then the first state the town is in). crier: a crier at the well on a market day (his post crier: news, calls, the day's prices). beggars: at the church step (post beg; more in hunger). patrol: guards walking the square's ring in a pair, stopping to look about (pause seconds, pace world units a second, ring as a share of the square's radius; more in war). dogs: town dogs (the Quaternius wolf, shrunk to a dog's length in metres and tinted a hound's brown) trotting after people, sniffing and lying about (trot pace, follow: how near they keep). chase: pairs of children chasing each other round the square (run pace, how far apart before the chaser turns back). gossip: knots of townsfolk talking, who turn to look at news (post gossip; knot size [fewest, most]; at_well: how many of the knots stand at the well, well_out game units toward the heart from it). The rest of docs/art/target/01-town's square (town_life.gd _square_more): guards_forge and guards_castle: guards in the house's colour (posted.lighten toward white) posted at the forge's yard (posted.forge_out ahead of its middle, game units) and along the castle's side that faces the square (castle_out from its wall, only when the castle stands within castle_within square radii); errands: townsfolk carrying a load from place to place across the square (the market, well, tavern, sept and forge), each load [the carrying move, the station, the sex, and "shoulder" for a sack slung on the shoulder: sack [up, back] metres from the shoulder bone and its size], set down a while (pause seconds, set_down the move) and taken up again, at pace; streets: errands go up the main streets too, to a point this many square radii out (0 keeps them on the square), street_share of the carriers taking one street into their round, between two places on the square; cart: a horse and cart rolling in along one main street (from: square radii out), to the market (market_in of the way to it) and out along the other, waiting stop seconds at each, sacks in its bed (load: how many, the bed's height and how far they run back along it, game units, and their size); yards: the gardens nearest the square (within square radii) kept: hens [fewest, most] and a pig by chance about the beds, and a gardener on their knees by chance. chase.sticks: the share of the children with a stick for a sword (chase.stick, a weapons.gd kind).
